[Thinking]
Okay, the user is asking "តើពេលណាដែលផ្កាយដើមកើតមក" which translates to "When was the first star born?" Let me recall what I know about the formation of the first stars.

I remember that the first stars in the universe are called Population III stars. They formed after the Big Bang, during the cosmic Dark Ages, which was a time before stars and galaxies existed. The universe was filled with hydrogen, helium, and trace amounts of other elements, but no heavier elements because those were created later in stars through nuclear fusion.

The Big Bang happened about 13.8 billion years ago. After that, the universe was a hot, dense plasma that gradually cooled. Around 400,000 years later, the temperature dropped enough for protons and electrons to combine into neutral hydrogen atoms, which ended the period of photon scattering and allowed the universe to become transparent. This is the time when the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) radiation was emitted.

The Dark Ages followed this, lasting from about 400,000 years after the Big bang until the first stars formed. I've heard that simulations and theoretical models suggest the first stars formed a few hundred million years after the Big Bang. But when exactly?

Recent studies using observations from the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) have found some very early galaxies and objects that might be among the first stars. For example, some galaxies like GN-z11 and JD1 are observed at very high redshifts, indicating they're from about 400 million to 300 million years after the Big Bang. However, distinguishing between individual stars and galaxies at that stage is challenging because they would be very faint and far away.

So the first stars, Population III, are thought to have formed in dark matter halos where gas could collapse without the presence of heavy elements. These stars were very massive, hot, and short-lived. They would have rapidly gone supernova, spreading the first heavier elements into the interstellar medium.

The exact timing might be between 100 million to 500 million years after the Big Bang. But I think the consensus is around a couple hundred million years, maybe 200 million? But I should check if there's a more precise estimate. Also, mention that it's challenging to observe them directly because their light is very old and redshifted, and they might have already died out. The JWST has been helping to push our observations further back, but definitive detection of Population III stars is still ongoing.

Also, note that our understanding keeps changing with new data. For example, the discovery of early galaxies might indicate that star formation started earlier than previously thought. So the exact time is still a topic of active research and observations.
[/Thinking]

ផ្កាយដំបូងគេត្រូវបានបង្កើតឡើងប្រហែលជា **រវាង 100 លានទៅ 500 លានឆ្នាំ** បន្ទាប់ពីការផៀងរំកិល (Big Bang)។ មន្ត្រីវិទ្យាសាស្ត្រប៉ាន់ស្មានថាផ្កាយកោសិកាសើប (Population III stars) ដំបូងផ្ទះនៅពេលដែលចក្រវាឡមានអាយុធៀបនឹងប្រហែល **200 លានឆ្នាំ** (តាមការប៉ាន់ស្មានអាចចំពោះមុខថា រវាង 130–300 លានឆ្នាំក្រោយ Big Bang)។ ផ្កាយទាំងនេះកើតឡើងពីដុំអាថ៌កំបាំងនៃឧស្ម័ន (ភាគច្រើនជាអ៊ីដ្រូសែន និងហេល្លីញ៉ូម) ដោយមិនមានធាតុធ្ងន់ដូចកាបូន ឬអុកស៊ីសែន។

### កត្តាសំខាន់ៗរបស់ផ្កាយដំបូង:
- **សភាវគតិ**: ផ្កាយបុរាណគឺមានម៉ាស់យ៉ាងខ្លាំង (ប្រហែល 10–300 ដងធំជាងអាទិត្យ) ហើយផ្ទះពីដំបូងទៅផ្ទះនឹងរវាង 1 លានទៅ 10 លានឆ្នាំប៉ុណ្ណោះ។
- **ឥទ្ធិពល**: ពួកវាផលិតធាតុធ្ងន់តាមរយៈនុយក្លេអ៊ែរស៊ីនទែន ហើយបង្ក់ទៅនឹងធ្យូងអាយ (supernova) ដើម្បីបំផ្ទុះធាតុទាំងនោះចេញក្នុងចក្រវាឡ។
- **ការមើលឃើញដោយបច្ចេកវិទ្យា**: មិនទាន់មានការសង្កេតផ្កាយកោសិកាសើបដោយផ្ទាល់ទេ ប៉ុន្តែការរកឃើញគោលាកាសលីលួច (galaxies) ដូចជា GN-z11 ឬ Maisie’s Galaxy ដែលមានវ័យប្រហែល 400 លានឆ្នាំបន្ទាប់ពី Big Bang មកជួយបញ្ជាក់ពីការបង្កើតផ្កាយដំបូង។

ការសិក្សាពីផ្កាយដំបូងកំពុងបន្តដោយប្រើទិន្នន័យពីមីសស៊ុលវិទ្យាសាស្ត្រដូចជា **James Webb Space Telescope (JWST)** ដែលអាចមើលឃើញពន្លឺចាស់ខ្លាំងពីថាមពលជំហានដើមរបស់ចក្រវាឡ។
